items.exampleEn: My legs are tired after the long walk.
items.exampleZh: 走了很長一段路，我的腿好累。

items.exampleEn: She puts her bag on her shoulder.
Don't talk with food in your mouth.

items.exampleEn: Reading is good for your brain.
I can't hear well in my left ear.

items.sentenceEn: Math games are good for your brain.

items.audioEn: My shoulder hurts, so I will see a doctor today.

items.sentenceEn: My shoulder hurts, so I can't carry my bag.

items.stemEn: My arm ____. I can't carry this box.
items.stemZh: 我的手臂好痛，搬不動這個箱子。

items.passageEn: Tom plays soccer every Saturday. Today, his leg hurts after the game. He goes to see a doctor. The doctor says it is not bad. "Stay at home and sleep early," she says. Tom says OK.
items.passageZh: Tom 每個星期六都踢足球。今天比賽後，他的腿很痛。他去看醫生，醫生說不嚴重。「待在家裡，早點睡。」醫生說。Tom 說好。

rubricZh: 「⋯痛」可用 … hurts（例如 My arm hurts），也可寫 I have a pain in my arm 等
主詞是單數時，hurt 要加 s

referenceEn: The doctor is on the second floor.
The doctor's office is on the second floor.
rubricZh: 「二樓」可寫，例如 the second floor 等（英式 the first floor 也正確）
doctor 前加冠詞或所有格，例如 the doctor、my doctor 等
